notes.text: This table excludes payments via Foreign Military Sales (FMS) agreements.
Where a contract is novated during the year, annual payments are shown against the new 'owner' (company or entity) of that contract.
Excluded are organisations with an approved disclosure exemption in line with Transparency guidelines.
Negative miscellaneous transactions have been removed in order to calculate percentages, but are included in the calculation of 2024/25 total spend figures.

The composition of holding companies in terms of their subsidiaries is derived as at 31 March in the financial year in question. The individual subsidiaries and joint ventures of suppliers have been derived by researching corporate structures contained on the Dun and Bradstreet database, and company revenues via the latest Annual Report and Accounts. The term 'holding company' refers to companies which are full or part owner of other companies (subsidiaries and joint ventures). Payments to joint ventures have been allocated to their parent holding companies in proportion to their equity holdings in those joint ventures as stated in the relevant company annual report.

Totals include expenditure by MOD Core Department and payments made directly to suppliers by UKHO and Dstl. The percentage of competitive spending presented in Table 4a will differ to that shown in Table 5c which is a measure of known competitive to non-competitive contract spend only. Other payment methods are excluded from calculations in Table 5c, as is contract expenditure where the competition status is unknown.

Excluded are all payments made to public sector bodies, government departments and agencies, local authorities, charities, and associations. Direct payments recorded under the code 'Non Registered Contractor', and payments made to international organisations such as the NATO Eurofighter and Tornado Management Agency (NETMA) and Organisation for Joint Armaments Co-operation Executive Administration (OCCAR) are included in total MOD spending, but it is not possible to assign these payments to individual contractors.
